text.en: Pet owners frequently praise the veterinarians, technicians, and front desk staff for their attentive and caring attitude during routine visits and urgent procedures. Clients highlight practitioners who listen to concerns and explain treatments. While most reviews are complimentary, one visitor described poor customer service.

Reviewers consistently emphasize the gentle handling and sincere concern shown toward their pets, including dogs recovering from surgery and young kittens requiring supportive medical attention. Multiple pet parents express gratitude for the patient, reassuring approach taken by the hospital staff during visits.

Clients report positive clinical outcomes following routine treatments and complex surgeries. Owners note that pets with serious injuries or illnesses improved steadily after receiving recommended procedures and medication. Several reviewers mention returning for multiple surgical interventions with full confidence.

q.en: Does Animal Care & Surgical Hospital perform pet surgeries?

a.en: Yes, clients frequently mention successful soft-tissue procedures and general surgeries performed at the clinic.

q.en: What animals does the clinic treat?

a.en: Reviewers report bringing both dogs and cats for checkups, surgical operations, and treatments.

q.en: Do clients need to schedule an appointment?

a.en: The clinic accepts scheduled visits through its online form and telephone booking during open hours.
